svg.text: A adds the stage to the rotation order, Y cycles its form (Normal / Omega / Battlefield), L/R pages.
L/R page D-pad move A change / open B back X reset page
Cursor: Small Battlefield — 3rd in the rotation, Normal form (Ω omega, BF battlefield form)
Docked: 5 x 8 per page, short names, pages of 40, 40 and 38. Tiles 17-40 are text placeholders: the mock has captures for the first 16 only.
